name: Wanjiru Kamau
quote: Maven Enterprise transformed our tired-looking home in three weeks. The team was punctual, tidy and the finish quality on our floors and bathroom is outstanding.

name: Arch. David Otieno
quote: As architects we need suppliers who understand specification and deadlines. Maven consistently delivers exactly what's on the drawings, on schedule.

name: Grace Mutua
quote: Their showroom and product range make it easy to source everything from wall panels to lighting in one place. Installation teams are reliable and skilled.

name: Samuel Kiprono
quote: We've used Maven Enterprise on four commercial projects now. Bulk pricing is fair and their project managers keep our sites moving without delays.

image.alt: Portrait of Samuel Kiprono, general contractor

name: Amina Hassan
quote: The fit-out team understood the coastal climate demands and recommended materials that have held up beautifully a year on. Highly recommended for hospitality projects.

image.alt: Portrait of Amina Hassan, hotel operations manager

name: Peter Ndungu
quote: For our apartment developments, having one supplier for décor, plumbing and kitchen fittings has simplified procurement enormously.
